meta.title: RR contract-B clean research L1 freeze
meta.description: Immutable experiment freeze for clean-feature + clean-label RR research. Does not authorize rr_fusion enable or production promote.

instrument_universe.notes: BNB-only epoch candidate. Matches incumbent train instrument (202605_bnb_v2). Multi-instrument claims require a superseding certificate with multi data in L2/L3.

sampling.notes: Do not rebalance to 50/50. Legacy run-id 'balanced' is not a design. Prefer PR-AUC over accuracy given low base rate (~6.5% on contaminated corpus is historical only).

spine_shadow_if_used.note: Any spine ledger A/B under this certificate uses gate ON; never rely on silent .env

measure_regime.notes: Primary kill-test = offline CV on clean (X,y) matrix with F-044 legacy confidence gate BYPASSED (raw ridge/GNB heads). Spine measurements if any are secondary and must declare BACKTEST_ENGINE_GATE=1 explicitly.

target_definition.notes: y_rr must be continuous realized R from governing exit — never forced +1.0 on wins (F-045 degeneracy ban). y_win is derived from y_rr sign for classification metrics only.

structure_mask_policy.notes: Structure dims (swings/BOS/HH-LL/etc.) stay ACTIVE but MUST be PIT-clean causal publication (FC1-A). Legacy zero mask matches incumbent rr_model zero_indices (price/EMA/MACD/body/wick). No centered-swing train population (F-051).

feature_list.notes: Frozen to CANONICAL_FEATURES order. L2 emits schema_hash over this list; loaders reject mismatch. volatility_regime must be rolling causal (FC1-D), not global-batch.

governing_exit.notes: Primary y only from forward_walk(intrabar_fixed) on entry geometry + candles. opportunities.jsonl outcome/rr_achieved are x-ref only (F-022).

success_failure_rules.keep_candidate_rule: label_validity_pass AND (rr_corr > 0.03 OR pr_auc_y_win > shuffle_pr_auc + 0.02) AND top_decile_mean_y_rr > random_decile_mean_y_rr; research authority only — not production weight
success_failure_rules.retire_rule: label_validity_pass AND rr_corr <= 0.03 AND pr_auc_y_win <= shuffle_pr_auc + 0.02 AND top_decile_mean_y_rr <= random_decile_mean_y_rr
success_failure_rules.insufficient_rule: n < min_samples_floor OR label_validity_fail OR fold_power_insufficient
success_failure_rules.notes: Supersedes contaminated F-045 numbers. KEEP_CANDIDATE never enables rr_fusion (hard_flags). F-044 gate remains bypassed for head eval under this certificate.
